risk_if_not_implemented: Without Motivated Intruder, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Personal Data (PD) Retention & Disposal
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to: 
(1) Retain Personal Data (PD), including metadata, for an organization-defined time period to fulfill the purpose(s) identified in the notice or as required by law;
(2) Dispose of, destroys, erases, and/or anonymizes the PD, regardless of the method of storage; and
(3) Use organization-defined techniques or methods to ensure secure deletion or destruction of PD (including originals, copies and archived records).
compensating_control_1.justification: Personal Data (PD) Retention & Disposal (PRI-30) provides privacy protection that compensates for the absence of Motivated Intruder (DCH-36.5) by applying alternative privacy safeguards to protect personal data and honor data subject rights. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: De-Identification (Anonymization)
compensating_control_2.justification: De-Identification (Anonymization) (DCH-36) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Motivated Intruder (DCH-36.5) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
